episode_summary: Megan Walters shares her journey from a 22-year-old new agent to a top 1% producer without buying leads or cold calling. She emphasizes the importance of personal branding, leveraging social media, and engaging with the community to generate business. Her approach to real estate investment and productivity offers actionable insights for agents looking to scale their business.
